description: This file provides a Micrometer-based implementation of metrics collection for the Eclipse Hono protocol adapter. It tracks connections, message payloads, command metrics, and tenant timeouts, integrating with Spring and Vert.x frameworks in a Java environment.

classes.name: MicrometerBasedMetrics
classes.description: Implements the Metrics interface, providing Micrometer-based metrics collection for connections, messages, commands, and tenant timeouts within the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: MicrometerBasedMetrics
methods.description: Constructor initializing the metrics component with a MeterRegistry and Vertx instance; registers a listener for meter removal to cleanup references.

methods.name: setProtocolAdapterProperties
methods.description: Autowired setter to configure tenant idle timeout from external ProtocolAdapterProperties.

methods.name: incrementConnections
methods.description: Increments the count of authenticated connections for a specific tenant.

methods.name: decrementConnections
methods.description: Decrements the count of authenticated connections for a specific tenant.

methods.name: incrementUnauthenticatedConnections
methods.description: Increases the count of unauthenticated connections.

methods.name: decrementUnauthenticatedConnections
methods.description: Decreases the count of unauthenticated connections.

methods.name: getNumberOfConnections
methods.description: Returns the current total number of active connections.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new timer sample for telemetry measurement.

methods.name: reportTelemetry
methods.description: Reports telemetry data for messages or events, recording metrics for received messages, outcomes, QoS, payload size, and optional tenant timeout status.

methods.name: reportCommand
methods.description: Reports command metrics, including direction, outcome, payload size, and timing.

methods.name: calculatePayloadSize
methods.description: Calculates effective payload size considering tenant-specific minimum message sizes, adjusting sizes accordingly.

methods.name: updateLastSeenTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the last seen timestamp for a tenant and schedules a timeout if tenant idle timeout is configured.

methods.name: newTenantTimeoutTimer
methods.description: Sets a Vert.x timer for tenant timeout handling based on last activity timestamp.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if a tenant currently has active authenticated connections.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles cleanup and notification when a tenant times out due to inactivity, removing metrics and publishing timeout event.
